items.passage: Transcript: Good afternoon, this is Joaquin Lindgren at the aquatics centre with changes for next week. The competition pool will be drained all next week for a filter repair. Open lap swimming normally runs there from six to eight in the morning. Next week, lap swimming moves to the diving pool, and because the divers train there first thing, the hours will be seven to nine. Beginner swim classes can't use the diving pool, since it's far too deep, so they'll meet in Room 125 for a dry-land water-safety lesson. The varsity swim team will practise at the city's public pool. Lap swimmers, the competition-pool locker rooms are closed as well, so please change in Room 456, beside the diving pool, where the fitness sessions are usually held. Questions? Call extension 9437.

'Have a dry-land fitness session in Room 456' takes the room where lap swimmers change and fitness sessions are usually held.
